title: Interior Designer & 3D Visualizer
description:
3D Visualizer – Architectural

**Company:** The Building Contractor (TBC) by Tribicon Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Thiruvankulam, Ernakulam, Kerala  
**Job Type:** Full\-time

Job Description

The Building Contractor (TBC) is looking for a creative and technically skilled **3D Visualizer** to join our Design Team.

The candidate will be responsible for converting architectural concepts and drawings into **high\-quality, realistic 3D visualizations** for residential and commercial projects.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop detailed **3D models and realistic architectural visualizations**.
* Create exterior and interior 3D views based on architectural drawings and concepts.
* Prepare realistic materials, textures, lighting and environments.
* Produce high\-quality renders for client presentations and project approvals.
* Develop façade concepts and support architects during design development.
* Convert AutoCAD drawings, sketches and design concepts into accurate 3D models.
* Revise 3D models and renders based on architect and client feedback.
* Ensure 3D visualization accurately represents the approved architectural design.
* Coordinate with Architects, Design Engineers and other members of the Design Team.
* Maintain organised project files, models, materials and render outputs.
* Support preparation of presentation materials when required.

Qualification

**Diploma / Degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Interior Design, 3D Visualization or related field**

Candidates with strong visualization skills and an excellent portfolio may also be considered irrespective of academic background.

Preferred Skills

* Strong knowledge of **SketchUp**.
* Good knowledge of **Lumion / D5 Render / Enscape / V\-Ray or similar rendering software**.
* Good understanding of **AutoCAD drawings**.
* Strong sense of architectural design, proportions, materials and colour combinations.
* Good knowledge of lighting, textures, landscaping and realistic rendering.
* Ability to understand floor plans, elevations and architectural drawings.
* Basic knowledge of Photoshop or other post\-production software will be an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail and visual quality.
* Ability to complete revisions within project timelines.

Experience

**1–3 years of relevant experience preferred.**

Freshers with **excellent software skills and a strong architectural visualization portfolio** may also be considered.

What We Look For

We are looking for a **creative, detail\-oriented and quality\-focused 3D Visualizer** who can transform architectural ideas into realistic and compelling visuals while maintaining practical alignment with the final building design.

**Portfolio submission is preferred along with the application.**

**Apply now to join The Building Contractor (TBC) by Tribicon Pvt. Ltd.**

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Interior Designer & 3D Visualizer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONINTERIOR DESIGNER CUM 3D VISUALISER

**Company:** Pipe Dreamers Collab  
**Position:** Interior Designer Cum 3D Visualiser  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Experience : 1 \+ years**  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala

ABOUT PIPE DREAMERS COLLAB

**Pipe Dreamers Collab** is an architecture, interior design and construction practice focused on creating thoughtful, sustainable and context\-responsive spaces.

Our approach combines **architecture, interiors, landscape and materiality** to create spaces that are functional, aesthetically refined and connected to their environment.

We are looking for a talented **Interior Designer Cum 3D Visualiser** who can contribute both creatively and technically to our design process.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Interior Designer Cum 3D Visualiser will be responsible for developing interior design concepts and transforming architectural and interior ideas into **high\-quality 3D models, realistic renders and compelling visual presentations**.

This is not purely a rendering role.

We are looking for someone who can **understand design, develop spaces, work with materials and translate concepts into strong visual outcomes**.

The role will involve visualisation across multiple scales, from:

**Interior Spaces → Buildings → Exteriors → Landscapes → Master Plans**

The ideal candidate should have strong practical proficiency in **SketchUp and professional rendering software such as D5 Render, Lumion, V\-Ray, Enscape or equivalent**.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. INTERIOR DESIGN \& SPACE PLANNING

* Understand client requirements, lifestyle and functional needs.
* Develop interior concepts and design directions.
* Prepare furniture layouts and space\-planning proposals.
* Develop interior schemes for living, dining, bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms and other spaces.
* Assist in selecting appropriate furniture, finishes, materials, colours, textures and lighting.
* Develop design solutions balancing **function, aesthetics, comfort and practicality**.
* Explore different design options and alternatives.
* Assist the design team in taking projects from initial concept to final design.

2\. 3D MODELLING \& VISUALISATION

The candidate will be responsible for developing high\-quality 3D visualisations across **interior, architectural exterior, landscape and master\-planning projects**.

INTERIOR VISUALISATION

* Create accurate and detailed 3D interior models.
* Produce high\-quality, realistic interior renders.
* Develop realistic furniture, materials, textures, lighting and decorative elements.
* Prepare different material and design options for client presentations.
* Create detailed views that communicate the overall design intent.

EXTERIOR ARCHITECTURAL VISUALISATION

Produce high\-quality exterior renders for:

* Residential buildings
* Villas
* Commercial buildings
* Apartment projects
* Building facades
* Architectural massing and forms
* Entrance areas
* Courtyards
* Terraces
* Outdoor spaces
* Day and night views
* Landscape\-integrated architectural views

MASTER PLAN \& SITE VISUALISATION

Develop **master plan and site\-level 3D visualisations**, including:

* Overall site/master plan views
* Villa/community developments
* Building layouts
* Roads and pathways
* Landscape and open spaces
* Water bodies
* Parking areas
* Common amenities
* Recreational spaces
* Outdoor gathering areas
* Site features and structures
* Aerial and bird's\-eye views

LANDSCAPE VISUALISATION

* Integrate architecture and landscape realistically.
* Develop vegetation, trees, planting, terrain and outdoor elements.
* Create visually convincing landscape environments.
* Represent the relationship between buildings, open spaces and the surrounding context.

OTHER VISUALISATION

* Architectural walkthroughs
* Fly\-throughs
* Animations
* Design presentation videos
* Conceptual visualisations
* Material and lighting studies

3\. DESIGN DEVELOPMENT

* Translate concepts into detailed and presentable interior proposals.
* Explore materials, colours, textures, furniture styles and lighting schemes.
* Develop mood boards and material palettes.
* Assist in preparing client presentations.
* Participate in design discussions with the architects and design team.
* Make revisions based on feedback from the Chief Architect, designers and clients.
* Ensure that the final 3D visualisation accurately represents the approved design.

4\. MATERIAL \& PRODUCT SELECTION

The candidate should have an interest in and understanding of:

* Natural materials
* Wood and wood finishes
* Natural and engineered stone
* Tiles
* Glass
* Metal
* Paint and wall finishes
* Fabrics and upholstery
* Lighting fixtures
* Furniture
* Hardware
* Modular cabinetry
* Kitchen finishes
* Sanitaryware and bathroom materials

The ability to **research materials, products and finishes and incorporate them accurately into the visualisation** will be an advantage.

5\. WORKING DRAWINGS \& INTERIOR DETAILING

A basic understanding of interior detailing and construction is expected.

The candidate should be able to understand and assist with:

* Furniture layouts
* Ceiling layouts
* Flooring layouts
* Electrical and lighting layouts
* Wall elevations
* Joinery and cabinetry
* Kitchen layouts
* Bathroom layouts
* Material specifications
* Interior detailing

Experience in preparing or understanding **working drawings** will be an added advantage.

6\. SOFTWARE REQUIREMENTSMANDATORY

**Strong practical proficiency in 3D modelling and rendering software is mandatory.**

The candidate must have strong working knowledge of:

* **SketchUp – Mandatory**
* **D5 Render / Lumion / equivalent professional rendering software – Mandatory**

PREFERRED

* V\-Ray
* Enscape
* Twinmotion
* AutoCAD
* Photoshop
* Illustrator

The candidate should be capable of independently handling the workflow:

**2D DRAWINGS → 3D MODELLING → MATERIALS → LIGHTING → LANDSCAPE → CAMERA COMPOSITION → RENDERING → POST\-PRODUCTION**

**Candidates without strong practical 3D modelling and rendering skills will not be considered.**

7\. MANDATORY SKILLS

The candidate must have:

* Strong **3D modelling skills**
* Strong **3D rendering skills**
* Proficiency in **SketchUp**
* Proficiency in **D5 Render, Lumion or equivalent**
* Good understanding of interior design principles
* Good spatial understanding
* Ability to read and understand architectural drawings
* Strong understanding of materials, textures and lighting
* Ability to create realistic architectural environments
* Strong visualisation and presentation skills
* Good sense of scale, proportion, composition and perspective
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to work within deadlines

8\. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for someone who combines:

**DESIGN THINKING \+ TECHNICAL SKILLS \+ VISUAL STORYTELLING**

You should be able to look at an empty room, building or site and understand:

**How should the space function?**  
**How should it feel?**  
**What materials should be used?**  
**How should the light interact with the space?**  
**How should the landscape complement the architecture?**  
**How can the entire idea be communicated through a compelling visual?**

We value candidates with a strong eye for:

* Composition
* Lighting
* Material realism
* Architectural proportions
* Furniture styling
* Landscape integration
* Atmosphere
* Photography and camera angles

An understanding of **minimal, contemporary, tropical and natural\-material\-based architecture and interiors** will be an added advantage.

9\. QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCEPreferred Qualification

* Degree / Diploma in Interior Design
* B.Arch / Architecture
* Diploma / Degree in Interior Architecture
* 3D Visualisation or related design fields

Experience

**1–3 years of relevant experience preferred.**

Freshers with an exceptionally strong portfolio demonstrating genuine interior design and 3D visualisation skills may also be considered.

PORTFOLIO IS MANDATORY

Candidates must submit a portfolio demonstrating their **own work**.

The portfolio should preferably include:

* Interior renders
* Exterior architectural renders
* Master plan / site visualisations
* Landscape visualisations
* SketchUp models
* D5 / Lumion / V\-Ray / Enscape renders
* Material and lighting studies
* Before/after or design development work, if available

10\. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

We are looking for someone who is:

* Creative and design\-oriented
* Technically strong
* Detail\-oriented
* Curious and willing to experiment
* Good at visual communication
* Fast and efficient
* Open to feedback
* Responsible with deadlines
* Comfortable working collaboratively
* Interested in architecture, interiors, materials and design
* Willing to continuously improve their visualisation skills

11\. ROLE \& REPORTING

The selected candidate will work closely with the **Chief Architect and Design Team**.

The role will involve active participation throughout the design process:

**CONCEPT DEVELOPMENT**  
↓  
**SPACE PLANNING**  
↓  
**MATERIAL \& DESIGN DEVELOPMENT**  
↓  
**3D MODELLING**  
↓  
**INTERIOR / EXTERIOR / MASTER PLAN VISUALISATION**  
↓  
**RENDERING**  
↓  
**CLIENT PRESENTATION**  
↓  
**DESIGN REFINEMENT**

The candidate will be expected to take ownership of assigned visualisation and interior design tasks and deliver work with a high level of **design quality, accuracy and presentation standards**.

12\. WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

At Pipe Dreamers Collab, we don't see 3D visualisation as simply **making beautiful images**.

Visualisation is an important part of our **design development process**.

The visualiser is expected to understand the design, question it, explore alternatives and help communicate the architectural idea.

You will work across **interiors, architecture, landscape and master planning**, giving you the opportunity to understand projects at both the **human scale and the larger site scale**.

We are looking for someone who can bring together:

**INTERIOR DESIGN \+ ARCHITECTURE \+ 3D MODELLING \+ MATERIALS \+ LIGHTING \+ VISUAL STORYTELLING**

If you are someone who gets excited about transforming a **floor plan, sketch or architectural concept into a beautiful, functional and believable space**, we would like to hear from you.

HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

* Updated CV / Resume
* **Portfolio of Interior Design \& 3D Visualisation work**
* Examples of **SketchUp \+ D5 / Lumion** projects
* Details of software proficiency
* Current salary and expected salary
* Availability / Notice Period

**Subject: Application – Interior Designer Cum 3D Visualiser**

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**UI/UX Designer**

**Company:** SpiderWorks Technologies  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**About the Role**

SpiderWorks Technologies is looking for a creative and user\-focused **UI/UX Designer** to join our team in Kochi. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing intuitive, visually appealing, and user\-friendly interfaces for websites, web applications, and mobile applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Understand project requirements, business objectives, and user needs.
* Conduct basic user research and competitor analysis.
* Create **user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity UI designs**.
* Design responsive and user\-friendly interfaces for websites and applications.
* Develop and maintain consistent design systems and UI components.
* Create interactive prototypes to demonstrate user journeys.
* Ensure designs work effectively across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
* Collaborate with developers, project managers, and other teams to ensure accurate implementation.
* Review implemented designs and provide feedback for improvements.
* Incorporate feedback from clients and internal stakeholders.
* Stay updated with current UI/UX trends and design best practices.
* Maintain well\-organized design files and documentation.

**Required Skills**

* Strong understanding of **UI/UX design principles**.
* Proficiency in **Figma**.
* Knowledge of wireframing and prototyping.
* Understanding of user flows and information architecture.
* Good understanding of responsive and mobile\-first design.
* Knowledge of typography, color theory, spacing, grids, and visual hierarchy.
* Basic understanding of usability and accessibility.
* Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of **Adobe XD, Photoshop, or Illustrator**.
* Basic understanding of **HTML and CSS**.
* Experience with design systems and reusable components.
* Knowledge of usability testing and user research.
* Experience designing websites, dashboards, SaaS products, e\-commerce platforms, or mobile applications.

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree/diploma in **UI/UX Design, Graphic Design, Interaction Design, Computer Science**, or a related field.
* Prior experience in UI/UX design will be an added advantage.
* Candidates must have a portfolio showcasing relevant UI/UX projects.

Candidates are requested to share their **Figma portfolio or design link** along with their updated resume. **Behance or Dribbble portfolio links** may also be included, if available.

description:

We are looking for a **talented and driven Architect** to join our innovative team. This is a fantastic opportunity for a professional with proven experience in architectural design and project execution who is eager to take the next step in their career. The ideal candidate will demonstrate creativity, technical proficiency, and a passion for delivering thoughtful, functional design solutions.

As an Architect, you will be involved in all phases of design and construction, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, consultants, and clients to bring projects from concept to completion.

* Ensure design compliance with local building codes, regulations, and sustainability standards.
* Conduct site visits and evaluations to monitor progress and ensure adherence to design specifications.
* Participate in client presentations and design reviews, effectively communicating design intent and progress.
* Manage project documentation and maintain organized records throughout the project lifecycle.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture.
* 3\-4 years of professional experience in a recognized architectural practice.
* Strong command of design software including AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, and Adobe Creative Suite.
* Thorough understanding of architectural design principles, detailing, and construction methodologies.
* Excellent visual, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong time management and organizational skills with an eye for detail.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Proficiency in 3D rendering tools such as Lumion, Enscape, or similar.

* Familiarity with local building bylaws and approval processes.
* A compelling portfolio showcasing a range of academic and professional design work.
* Experience in Interior Designing
